summary: Add a visual model of interference fringes and focused practice on phase, fringe order and experimental evidence.

improvements.why: The note describes alternating bright and dark fringes entirely in words; a labelled intensity profile makes maxima, minima and adjacent-fringe spacing visible for outcomes 9702-8.3.3 and 9702-8.3.4.
improvements.what: Use graph_sketch for light intensity against screen position: smooth repeated peaks and zero minima, central bright fringe, and an annotation marking $x$ between adjacent bright peaks. Explain in the note that equal source amplitudes allow zero-intensity minima.

improvements.why: Current items have no structured interpretation of fringe order; the examiner report for 9702 w22 P12 Q29 identifies confusion between wavelength, fringe spacing and second-order dark-fringe path difference.
improvements.what: Add one structured exam-style item that first calculates wavelength from $\lambda=ax/D$ then finds the path difference at the second dark fringe, $3\lambda/2$; add one MCQ that contrasts peak-plus-peak reinforcement with peak-plus-trough cancellation on a wavefront diagram. Include three useful hints and explanations.

improvements.why: The demonstration outcome has mostly short-answer practice and only one MCQ; it needs a decision about how coherence is produced and how a pattern is observed.
improvements.what: Add a structured Describe item on a ripple tank requiring two dippers on one vibrator, comparable amplitudes and a stroboscope or camera; add an MCQ selecting the valid shared-source and detector setup for sound or microwaves, with distractors for independent drives and missing detection.

improvements.where: note, after the dark-fringe sentence in ## Exam technique
improvements.why: The note warns about dark-fringe path difference but gives no worked way to count fringe order; ER 9702 w22 P12 Q29 reports this exact error.
improvements.what: Add a compact example: from the central maximum, first dark fringe has path difference $\lambda/2$ and second dark fringe $3\lambda/2$; state that $x$ is the spacing between adjacent fringes of the same kind and is not itself a path difference.
